dressmakerguide.com is an unofficial fan site. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, approved by or connected to the Dressmaker development team, Cozy Lives, Free Lives, Valve Corporation, itch.io, or any of their subsidiaries or partners.

Nothing on this site is an official statement. Nothing here should be read as a promise about the game's content, price, features, platform support or release schedule. For anything official, use the Steam store page, the official Steam announcements and the itch.io devlog.

"Dressmaker", the Dressmaker logo, character art, screenshots, music and all related assets are the property of their respective owners. They appear on this site for identification, commentary, criticism and review only.

  • We do not host or redistribute the game, its build files, its assets or its soundtrack.

Accuracy, and how we handle uncertainty

We check facts against primary sources - the official Steam store page, the official Steam news hub, the itch.io prototype page and the official devlog. Where the developers have not published something, we say so rather than guessing.

That said: prices change, launch discounts expire, specifications get edited, patches land. Always treat the official Steam page as more current than this site. Pages here carry a last-updated date; if a page looks stale, assume it might be.

If you spot an error, please report it. Corrections are welcome and are made quickly.

No professional advice

Guides on this site are about how to play a video game. They are not legal, financial, medical or professional advice of any kind. The same goes for our system requirements page, which explains what the developers published rather than recommending hardware purchases.

Real-world dressmaking is a genuine trade with real techniques, real risks and real safety considerations around cutting tools, machines and irons. If you want to sew real garments, learn from a qualified instructor or a reputable published source. This site cannot teach you that, and does not try.

Advertising and independence

This site may display advertising, including through Google AdSense, to cover hosting costs. Advertising is served by third parties, is clearly advertising, and is never mixed into editorial content.

  • We do not accept payment for reviews, rankings or placement.

See the privacy policy for how advertising cookies work and how to turn them off.

External links are provided for convenience. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content, their policies or their accuracy.

Trademark notice for search engines and readers

If you arrived here searching for dressmaker, dressmaker game, dressmaker demo or dressmaker steam, you are in the right place for the video game. If you arrived searching for dressmaking patterns, tailoring courses or the dressmaking profession, you are not: this site covers a cozy simulation game, not a trade. Our games like Dressmaker page is a better starting point if you want more games in this style.
